targets.approach: Park at the top of 29th Street and hike the trail around toward the south to the first major canyon. Cross the small bridge and hike up the drainage, keeping to the trail on the north side, to the base of the climbs. It begins left of the waterfall's fall line in a right-facing dihedral, gained from a few ledges, and follows the crack system that parallels the ice route, staying dry.
targets.name: Malans Crack

targets.approach: Pick up the bike trail by the parking area, walk uphill, then follow the clear trail that drops to the crag. The route is reached from the top of the cliff: once the Window Crack Hole comes into view, continue southwest along the cliff top to the easiest way down on your right, then pass two short sport routes to a corner with double cracks.
targets.descent_text: Once on top, build an anchor if needed and cross to the trail along the cliff top.
targets.name: Clippin' Cams Not Bolts
